metadata.description: Synthetic test queries for Article 1: RAG baseline evaluation
metadata.revision_notes: v1.0 held 300 rows but only 152 distinct questions, and 97 source_docs references pointed at files that did not exist after the corpus grew from 40 to 200 documents. v2.0 keeps the first occurrence of each distinct question (ids are unchanged, so they are not contiguous), drops 2 questions with no dedicated document in the corpus (q032, q042), and relabels every remaining question against the 200-document corpus.
metadata.label_policy: source_docs lists the documents whose main subject is what the question asks about, at most three. Comparison questions get the dedicated document for each side. Labels were assigned by reading document titles and section headings, not by running a retriever, and were reviewed by a single reviewer. expected_answer text is unchanged from v1.0.
